observation.command:
cd /workspace
echo "=== Keycloak ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "keycloak root: %{http_code}\n" --max-time 15 http://keycloak.workspace.localhost/
echo "=== Keycloak realms ==="; curl -s --max-time 15 http://keycloak.workspace.localhost/realms/ | head -c 300; echo
echo "=== Backend health (via api proxy) ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "api: %{http_code}\n" --max-time 15 http://api.workspace.localhost/health
echo "=== Backend direct ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "backend :8081/health: %{http_code}\n" --max-time 15 http://spring-app.workspace.internal:8081/health 2>/dev/null || echo "internal name not resolvable from host (expected)"
echo "=== app (dev server, may 502 if not up) ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "app: %{http_code}\n" --max-time 15 http://app.workspace.localhost/
echo "=== cms ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "cms: %{http_code}\n" --max-time 15 http://cms.workspace.localhost/
